description: This beautiful unit with balcony is located in the center of Paris, between the Opera district and Madeleine. Whether it's for a business trip or a visit to our beautiful capital, we offer you the chance to live like a Parisian during your stay, while enjoying the services of a 5-star residence.The spaceThese two apartments, connected by a private airlock, are fully air-conditioned/heated consist of two bedrooms, each with a king-size bed and a work area, two bathrooms, two living rooms with sofa beds, two flat-screen smart TVs with Chromecast and two fully equipped kitchens including a Nespresso coffee machine. Luxury toiletries, quality towels and bed linen, as well as various amenities, are provided to make you feel at home. We also offer high-speed Wi-Fi, a printer and a scanner for your convenience.Guest accessA code will be provided to you prior to your arrival to access your apartment autonomously and securely. Additionally, a person will be available on-site to assist you if needed.Other things to noteWe would like to inform our dear guests that some renovation work will be conducted from August 04th to 15th in the residency's roof top. You will not be disturbed as it will take place in the roof top and unaccessible areas of the ground floor, except for some noise that may occur in those areas from 10:30 am to 4:30 pm, which our team will do their utmost to limit.We apologies in advance for any inconvenience and remain available should you need further assistance.
